name: RAGfly
description: Document retrieval for agents, exposed through MCP tools and a separate RBAC-filtered REST operations manifest.

mcp.auth: OAuth 2.1 or Authorization: Bearer rf_xxxxxxxxxx (API Key issued from a human session)
mcp.scope: Every call is filtered by the key owner’s organization, workspace, area and role. Flexible workspace focus is stored server-side.

tools.name: session
tools.description: Verifies the connection and returns the identity and the active organization, workspace and area

tools.name: set_active_workspace
tools.description: Sets an authorized workspace for a flexible key or releases focus with null; fixed keys cannot change workspace

tools.name: unset_active_workspace
tools.description: Releases the workspace focus (same as `set_active_workspace` with null): back to the identity's default workspace scope

tools.name: list_operations
tools.description: What this key can do: every operation its RBAC allows, with `kind` and `confirm_required`

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: One operation with its `input_schema` and `output_schema`

tools.name: run_operation
tools.description: Runs one operation. A `write_confirm` one only runs with `confirm=true`; otherwise it returns a preview

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Lists organization documents with filters

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Full detail of a document

tools.name: document_edges
tools.description: Corpus-graph edges of a document: neighbors and documents at 2 hops

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Lists the organization's Collections

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Collection detail: criteria + documents + queue

tools.name: compose_collections
tools.description: Set algebra (COMPOSE) of two Collections → a new Collection handle

tools.name: read_collection
tools.description: Materialize a Collection (READ) at a chosen resolution, paginated

tools.name: refresh_collection
tools.description: Re-applies the Collection's natural-language criteria and re-materializes its set (picks up newly qualifying documents)

tools.name: save_collection
tools.description: Saves a temporary Collection (`TEMPORARY`) as a saved one (`SAVED`)

tools.name: wiki_index
tools.description: Index of the compiled-knowledge pages visible from the active area. **Not available to integrator keys today (403)**

tools.name: wiki_page
tools.description: One compiled-knowledge page. **Not available to integrator keys today (403)**

tools.name: compile_collection
tools.description: Compiles a Collection (background job). The leaf skill must be one your access can run; the default public code is `COMPILE_PAGE`

tools.name: queue
tools.description: Current state of the processing pipeline

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Skill run history

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: User capabilities: available functions + LLM skills (RBAC-filtered)

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: LLM skills available to you (the same list as `catalog`)

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Skill detail: type and output; prompt and model only if your role administers skills

tools.name: run_skill
tools.description: Queues a run over a collection or document

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Direct semantic search over the corpus. `filter` narrows by document type, file attributes and content characteristics (codes from `list_document_types` and `list_characteristics`); a valid filter answers `filter_not_available` until structured filters are enabled for the organization

tools.name: list_document_types
tools.description: Document types of the workspace as a tree, with parent, synonyms and document counts. Picking a type also covers its more specific types

tools.name: list_characteristics
tools.description: Content characteristics (a date, an amount, an ID, a person…) available for the given types and their more specific ones

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Natural language question with full RAG (non-streaming). `mode: "help"` answers questions about RAGfly itself instead, without links to web screens

tools.name: set_active_area
tools.description: Set or release an organizational area focus

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: List visible organizational areas

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List visible document folders

tools.name: get_agent_context
tools.description: Authenticated layered prompt, identity, allowed tools and limits for Agentic Retrieval. Tool names are stable English identifiers; the available list and schemas depend on identity/profile

tools.name: run_agent_tool
tools.description: Runs one tool from the current authenticated AgentContext

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Reads this organization's profile and what is still missing

tools.name: update_organization
tools.description: Writes the profile. Needs an administrator of the organization

tools.name: draft_organization
tools.description: Proposes the four profile texts from a source text. Does **not** save

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Plan quotas against what is already consumed

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: Conversation history; its ids feed `ask`

tools.name: delete_conversation
tools.description: Deletes a conversation and its messages. Not reversible

tools.name: list_processes
tools.description: Process instances: support, requests, collection jobs

tools.name: get_process
tools.description: One process in full, with description and comments

tools.name: update_process
tools.description: Updates the fields the "My Processes" screen lets a person edit

operations.description: Separate manifest catalog of screen operations allowed by the credential after RBAC filtering. Its entries are not MCP tools.

resources.titulo: Configurar conectores de ingesta: Google Drive y Dropbox
resources.descripcion: Cuando una persona necesite conectar Google Drive o Dropbox, acompáñala con estas guías. No es una tool MCP, un comando CLI, una operación REST ni una función del SDK: el administrador configura la aplicación y los parámetros del grupo directamente en RAGfly; cada usuario autoriza su propia cuenta y elige la carpeta en el navegador.
reglas_seguridad: Nunca pidas, recibas, almacenes ni repitas secretos de cliente, access tokens, refresh tokens, contraseñas, cookies o códigos OAuth.
Indica al administrador que ingrese las credenciales de aplicación solo en Parámetros de Grupo de RAGfly; el agente solo describe los pasos y verifica requisitos no sensibles.
No intentes completar la autorización OAuth ni seleccionar carpetas fuera del navegador y la sesión del usuario.
